lines.en: : What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Oooh! This place reminds me of that movie about the wizard from Oz! I think it needs a few more bricks, though. I’m not sure if this really constitutes a {i}road.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦哦！这地方让我想起那部关于奥兹国巫师的电影！不过我觉得它还差几块砖。我不确定这到底算不算一条{i}路{/i}。

lines.en: : More of a trail, I’d say.
lines.zh: : 要我说，更像条小径。

lines.en: : Yeah, something like that. It’s kind of sad that we won’t be able to walk on it, though.
lines.zh: : 对，差不多。不过有点可惜，我们没法在上面走。
: 没法？为什么？

lines.en: : Hmm...it’d probably just make more sense to show you. Watch.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概直接给你看更好懂。看着。
: 哎哟！

lines.en: : Amy, are you okay? You immediately fell on those rocks before you could even show me why we can’t walk on them.
lines.zh: : Amy，你没事吧？你还没来得及给我演示为什么不能在上面走，就直接摔在那堆石头上了。

lines.en: : It’s because they aren’t {i}rocks{/i} at all! They’re slimy gallstones from the mall frog! My legs aren’t built for traversing them!
lines.zh: : 因为那根本不是{i}石头{/i}！那是商场青蛙身上滑溜溜的胆结石！我的腿不是用来在这种东西上行走的！

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess that rules out using them to go anywhere else then. Unfortunate.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那我想用它们去别处这条路也断了。真不巧。

lines.en: : Could you give me a hand, Akira? I seem to have misplaced mine!
lines.zh: : 能拉我一把吗，Akira？我好像把自己的手放丢了！
: 你保证不会留着不还？
: 哈哈！不行。

lines.en: : I’m kind of reluctant to help you up then. I imagine I’m going to need these hands eventually.
lines.zh: : 那我还真有点不想拉你起来了。我想我迟早还得用上这两只手。

lines.en: : Awww, come on! I was only kidding! It’s been so long since I’ve taken anybody’s hands in an attempt to sew them onto myself!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样！我只是开玩笑！我都好久没抢别人的手来缝到自己身上了！

lines.en: : If only I remembered you need hands in order to sew...
lines.zh: : 要是我记得缝东西需要手就好了……

lines.en: : If I learned how to sew, could I do it for you? Or do the hands just not work since they never belonged to you in the first place?
lines.zh: : 如果我学会缝纫，能替你缝吗？还是说那些手因为本来就不属于你，所以根本用不了？

lines.en: : We could try! Worst case scenario, I just keep being me.
lines.zh: : 可以试试！最坏的情况也就是我继续当我自己。

lines.en: : I like you the way you are, though, Amy. So that just sounds like the best case scenario to me.
lines.zh: : 不过我就喜欢你现在的样子，Amy。所以对我来说那听起来反而是最好的情况。
: A……Akira……

lines.en: : It’s no fair if you say that while I’m still lying on the ground! Come and help me up!
lines.zh: : 我还躺在地上呢，你这么说太不公平了！过来拉我起来！

lines.en: : Unless...you plan on...{i}taking advantage of me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 除非……你打算……{i}占我便宜？{/i}

lines.en: : Ohhh nooooo! Whatever will I do?! I can barely move on all these slippery gallstones! I sure hope {i}nobody named Akira{/i} does anything to my {i}helpless{/i} body!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦不不不！我该怎么办啊？！在这些滑溜溜的胆结石上我几乎动不了！我真希望{i}没有哪个叫 Akira 的人{/i}对我这具{i}无助的{/i}身体做什么！

lines.en: : Amy, you’re making a scene. The people in the trees are watching us.
lines.zh: : Amy，你在闹场。树上的人在看着我们。

lines.en: : The people in the trees are {i}always{/i} watching us. Now get over here and-
lines.zh: : 树上的人{i}永远{/i}都在看着我们。现在过来，然后——

lines.en: : Woah. I didn’t even have to do anything.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。我什么都还没做呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I just respawned. They think of {i}everything{/i} here, don’t they? The regular mall {i}never{/i} respawns me when I get stuck on my back like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想我刚刚刷新了。他们这儿真是{i}什么都{/i}想到了，对吧？我像那样背朝下卡住的时候，普通商场{i}从来不{/i}给我刷新。

lines.en: : You’re enjoying the Blissful Biosphere then?
lines.zh: : 那你挺喜欢极乐生物圈？
: 哦，当然！我超爱！

lines.en: : But there’s still so much to explore!
lines.zh: : 但还有好多东西要探索！

lines.en: : Just don’t make me walk on the gallstones again, please...
lines.zh: : 只是别再让我走那些胆结石了，拜托……
